Data audit sampled: Mega Flare power 14 (re-ffx2-commands.md), Yunalesca 25.7 wing tips x 1.82 / 18.15 = 2.577 (ffx-yunalesca.md 18.5), Sin turn 12 (re-ffx-ai-evrae-yojimbo-isaaru-sin.md D-31), Yojimbo band odds 25/25/50 (same note 3.2). issues.title: Chapter XVIII is won by 3 of 500 seeds of the built-in line and no real-input win was reached
issues.expected: The chapter stays winnable by a human route (the owner chose the game's 12-turn clock and to retune later: "Ship 12, retune our line later").
issues.observed: I reproduced the RE session's number in the engine (the shipped line wins seeds 118, 124 and 129 of 1 to 500, in 63 to 65 party turns). Real-UI routes driven by the advisor lost at seed 1 and at seed 118 (58 turns, defeat). No human-pace route is shown to win, so "winnable by any route" is unproven, though three engine wins show it is not impossible. The guide card still says 13 turns. The rule is the owner's decision and is not itself the defect.
